```{python}
import pandas as pd
import json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import os

# Ensure the src directory is in the path for imports
sys.path.append(os.path.abspath(".."))
from src.scientific_dev.data_manager import HiggsDataManager
from src.scientific_dev.schema import DataConfig

sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid")

# Initialize Data Manager
data_config = DataConfig(parquet_path="../data/higgs.parquet")
dm = HiggsDataManager(data_config)

# Discover results
results_dir = Path("../results")
has_results = results_dir.exists() and any(results_dir.glob("**/*.json"))

if has_results:
    # Use our new DuckDB aggregator to pull ALL results
    sweep_df = dm.aggregate_sweep_results("../results")
    
    # Extract the last loss for comparison
    sweep_df['final_loss'] = sweep_df['training_history'].apply(lambda x: x[-1]['loss'] if x else None)
else:
    # Dummy data for demonstration
    sweep_df = pd.DataFrame({
        'exp_name': ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D'],
        'architecture': ['128-64', '256-128', '128-64', '512-256'],
        'lr': [0.001, 0.001, 0.0001, 0.0001],
        'final_loss': [0.45, 0.42, 0.48, 0.41]
    })
```

## Sweep Comparison

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Performance Overview
```{python}
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 5))
sns.barplot(data=sweep_df, x='architecture', y='final_loss', hue='lr')
plt.title("Final Loss by Architecture and Learning Rate")
plt.ylabel("Binary Cross-Entropy Loss (Lower is better)")
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.show()
```

### Raw Sweep Data
```{python}
from IPython.display import display, Markdown
display(sweep_df[['exp_name', 'architecture', 'lr', 'final_loss']].sort_values('final_loss'))
```

## Data Analysis (via DuckDB)

```{python}
if Path(data_config.parquet_path).exists():
    df = dm.get_summary_stats()
    
    plt.figure(figsize=(10, 4))
    sns.barplot(data=df, x='label', y='avg_lepton_pt')
    plt.title("Average Lepton pT by Label (Full 11M Rows)")
    plt.show()
else:
    print("Note: Higgs Parquet data not found. Dataset analysis will appear here after the Ingest step.")
```
